segments.text: "You want an adult sort of relationship with your little sister? No, that's wrong!"
Yuuto's adoptive sister, and Anri's older twin sister. She's half British and half Japanese, and has gorgeous, natural blonde hair.
She's cheerful, emotionally expressive, and easy to get along with. Thanks to Yuuto's inspiration, she works hard doing volunteer work.
She tends to blush easily when exposed to X-rated things. She loves Yuuto dearly as a brother... but maybe as more than just a brother?
From NekoNyan
優人の義妹で、杏璃の双子の姉。
イギリス人と日本人のハーフで、綺麗なブロンド髪が特徴。
明るく感情豊かで、ノリのいい女の子。
優人の影響で、ボランティア活動に精を出している。
『あだるてぃ』なことに免疫がなく、赤面する癖がある。
優人を兄として慕っているのだが……。
優人的义妹，杏璃的双胞胎姐姐。
英日混血儿，一头漂亮的金发是她的最大特征。
性格开朗感情丰富的女孩子。
受到優人的影响常参加志愿者活动。
对“成人”（adulty）的事物没有免疫力，立马就会面红耳赤。
虽然对優人是以哥哥来仰慕着，但……
“居然想和妹妹寻求成人般的关系，真是太不道德了！”
"Onii-cha– Ahem. Yuuto-san. I'll be managing all your needs as your little sister."
Yuuto's adoptive sister, and Anzu's younger twin sister. Although Anri is half British, like her twin sister, her Japanese traits are more dominant.

She's a very cool, mild-natured person who also works as her grade's student representative. She is also notoriously acid-tongued, and acts mature and sensible at all times, but in truth, she's a child at heart.

She's slightly interested in Yuuto as a member of the opposite sex, but acts somewhat uncaring towards him without realizing it. She is also a rather covetous person. Once you set off her jealousy, her mind enters "search & destroy" mode.
From NekoNyan
優人の義妹で、杏鈴の双子の妹。
イギリス人のハーフだが、日本人の特徴が色濃く出ている。
学年主席で落ち着いた性格のしっかり者。
トゲトゲしい言動で大人ぶってるが、根は子供。
優人を異性として見ているが、つい裏腹な態度を取る。
嫉妬深く、泥棒猫は『さーち＆ですとろい』
優人的另一个义妹，杏鈴的双胞胎妹妹。
虽然是英日混血儿，但是发色却完全继承了日本方面。
成绩年级第一，是个性格沉着冷静能干的人。
虽然说话话中带刺想装大人，但实际上还是个小孩子。
把優人当做异性看待，但总是采取与之相反的态度。
嫉妒心很强，对花心采取SEARCH&DESTROY的态度。
“能对哥……優人为所欲为的，只有身为他妹妹的我一个人”
"Yuu. Can we have sex?"
A childhood friend of Yuuto's , younger by one year, and also Hikaru's older identical twin sister. Hekiru has beautiful, sapphire eyes, and is a gifted artist.
She speaks in a monotone voice and marches to the beat of her own drum, sucking people in around her via her mysterious aura.
She claims that she came to Japan to fulfill a certain promise...
And her objective is—Yuuto's virginity?!
From NekoNyan
優人のひとつ下の幼馴染み。
ヒカルの双子の姉。
宝石のような綺麗な瞳を持つ、若き天才画家。
淡々とした喋り方をするマイペースな子で、周囲を不思議空間に巻き込む。
ある『約束』を果たしに、１０年ぶりに日本へ。
その目的は……優人の貞操！？
小優人一岁的青梅竹马。
ヒカル的双胞胎姐姐。
拥有宝石般漂亮的双眼的年少天才画家。
说话口气冷淡，富有个性，总能把周围人引入到不可思议的空间里。
为了实现10年前的“约定”回到了日本。
而她的目的……居然是優人的贞操！？
"Any guy can get lost. Hekiru belongs to me and no one else!"
A childhood friend of Yuuto's , younger by one year, and also Hekiru's younger identical twin sister. Hikaru boasts that she and Hekiru are "mirror" twins (with full bilateral symmetry.)
She's a popular model with a slight boyish appeal. Her speech is calculated and glib, and she handles everything flawlessly in a matter-of-fact fashion.
She's also a noted misandrist whose affection towards Hekiru transcends both sisterly and sexual boundaries. As such, she is often cold and unforgiving towards Yuuto.
From NekoNyan
優人のひとつ下の幼馴染み。
双子の姉であるヘキルとは、ミラーツイン（身体的特徴が左右対称）。
中性的な魅力で人気のモデル。
言葉巧みで計算高く、何でもそつなくこなすが何事にもドライ。
男嫌いでヘキルに姉妹と性の枠を越えた『愛』を注いでおり、優人を小うるさい蠅のように扱う。
小優人一岁的青梅竹马。
和双胞胎姐姐碧瑠是镜像双胞胎。
（原文ミラーツイン=mirror twin，身体特征左右对称）
富有中性魅力的人气模特。
擅长花言巧语和算计，凡事都能顺利完成，但都没太大兴趣。
讨厌男性，对姐姐碧瑠抱有超越姐妹关系以上的爱。
把優人当成烦人的苍蝇对待。
“男人快滚一边去，碧瑠是我的！”
"Shut up, Jerk! Go find some other girl to be your stupid pretend girlfriend or whatever!"

Tsubame's best friend, who works hard at her part-time job to provide for her family, since she was raised in a single-mother household. Izumi looks cute on the outside, but her personality, unfortunately, is anything but.
She's rowdy and ostentatious, but always hides her true feelings. She's also quite cowardly and weak-willed, always clinging to others for help.
She proclaims herself to be Yuuto's "rival" and always verbally harasses him, but to all outsiders, it only appears as though she's flirting with him.
From NekoNyan
母子家庭を支えるためバイト中心の生活を送る、つばめの親友。
見た目は可愛いのに中身が残念。
騒々しく見栄っ張りで、素直じゃない性格。
根はヘタレで、弱気になると人に抱きつく癖がある。
優人の自称ライバルな幼なじみでよく悪態をつくが、傍目からみれば惚気にしか聞こえない。
为了支持母女单亲生活过着以打工为中心的生活，つばめ的好友。
看起来可爱，但实际上是个残念的女孩子。
吵闹且爱面子，不坦率。
内心很胆小，软弱起来就爱抱着别人。
自称是優人的对手，常说他的坏话。但在旁人看来完全就是在秀恩爱。
“烦死了笨蛋，想谈恋爱找别的女孩子去啊！”
"Could we... stay like this?"
A member of the theater club and Torakichi's younger twin. Tsubame and Yuuto have always been in the same class at school, ever since they were little, and they're good friends because of that.
She's always ready to help with her ingenuous smile, and is revered as an idol within the school due to her attractive assets.
Unfortunately, due to her timid nature and lack of self-confidence, she has trouble fully expressing herself both on the stage and in front of the boy she likes.
From NekoNyan
演劇部に所属している、虎吉の双子の妹。
優人とは、子供の頃からずっと一緒のクラス。
面倒見の良さと素朴な笑顔、スタイルの良さから学園のアイドルとして神聖視されている。
少々臆病な性格であり、自分に自信がなくて恋も演技も『実力』を出し切れていない。
所属演剧部，虎吉的双胞胎妹妹。
和優人从小就是同班同学。
爱照顾人，并且笑容迷人，在加上身材也不错。
在学校被视作神圣的偶像。
性格有些胆怯，对自己没有信心，不管在恋爱还是在表演方面都没有发挥出真正实力。
“就一直这样下去……不行么？”
"I'm sorry. I'd really love to, but I have to study..."
The daughter of the school board chairman, and niece of Saionji-sensei. Mizuho is also the class representative for Yuuto's class.
She's a serious bookworm who's far too shy to look other people in the eye. She also has a rather weak constitution, which often causes her to have to go to the nurse's office due to anemia.
From NekoNyan
学園理事長の娘で、西園寺先生の姪。
優人のクラスで委員長をしている。
本の虫で伏し目がちな女の子。
身体が弱く、よく貧血を起こしては保健室に運ばれている。
学校理事长的女儿，西園寺老师的侄女。
担任優人班的班长。
书虫一个，总是低着头。
身体不好，经常因为贫血被送到保健室。
“对不起，我还要学习……”
"Don't you be callin' me puddin' head!"
Tsubame's older twin brother, and Yuuto's best friend since childhood. Torakichi, like his sister, is also a member of the theater club.

He's a hot-blooded fellow who's always trying to chat up a cute girl or two, but his efforts always end in rejection due to his dim-wittedness. But don't give up, Torakichi-kun! You'll get there some day!
From NekoNyan
つばめの双子の兄で、優人とは幼い頃からの親友。
演劇部所属。
熱血軟派な肉食系男子だが、おバカなためにいつも軽くあしらわれている。
頑張れ、虎吉くん！
CV：本間かいな　幼少期CV：桜川未央

演劇部所属。
熱血軟派な肉食系男子だが、おバカなためにいつも軽くあしらわれている。
頑張れ、虎吉くん！
「脳みそプリン言うなや！」
"Bwahaha! You're interesting! I like you!"
Anzu and Anri's biological father, and the director of a trading company. His wife unfortunately passed away at an early age, but he loves and treasures his daughters more than the world.
A stout-hearted, broad-built man who might need to act with a bit more prudence at times. This scores him regular scoldings by Shion.
From NekoNyan
杏鈴と杏璃の実父で、貿易会社の社長。
妻に先立たれており、娘達をとても大事にしている。
豪胆で情に厚い人だが細かいことを気にしなさすぎて、よく小言を頂戴する。
杏鈴と杏璃の実父で、貿易会社の社長。
妻に先立たれており、娘たちをとても大事にしている。
豪胆で情に厚い人だが細かいことを気にしなさすぎて、よく小言を頂戴する。
「ガッハッハッ！　面白い、気に入ったぞ」
"Yes, let us discuss things peacefully."
The Takakura family maid, and tutor to Yuuto and his sisters. Shion is in a romantic relationship with her employer, Yoshiomi, and the days are counting down to their wedding.
She's cheerful with a slight hint of mischievousness. When angered, she becomes an indomitable queen who uses her Death Grip (of Love) to dole out punishment.
From NekoNyan
鷹倉家のメイド兼、優人達の教育係。
雇い主である義臣とは恋仲にあり、結婚秒読み段階。
明るくお茶目な性格だが、怒ると笑顔を浮かべながら『愛アンクロー』をかましてくる女帝。

鷹倉家のメイド兼、優人達の教育係。
雇い主である義臣とは恋仲にあり、結婚秒読み段階。
明るくお茶目な性格だが、怒ると笑顔を浮かべながら『愛アンクロー』をかましてくる女帝。
「ええ、平和的に話し合いましょう」
"Welp, have fun, kids! You're only young once."
The school nurse and provisional adviser to the theater club. She's somewhat of an acting guardian for Hekiru and Hikaru as a distant relative of theirs.
It can be hard to make sense of her personality and everything she does. She's a blizzard princess who reels off lousy jokes with each icy breath.
From NekoNyan
学園の養護教諭で、演劇部の代理顧問。 ヘキルとヒカルの遠い親戚で、何かと面倒を見ている。
掴み所のない浮雲のような人。息をするように寒いギャグを飛ばす『ブリザードプリンセス』
学園の養護教諭で、演劇部の代理顧問。 ヘキルとヒカルの遠い親戚で、何かと面倒を見ている。
掴み所のない浮雲のような人。息をするように寒いギャグを飛ばす『ブリザードプリンセス』
「んじゃまー、適当に青春しててねん」
He lived in an orphanage in England with his friend, Nodoka, before being adopted by Yoshiomi Takakura.

A young man with an amicable personality, he’s the type who puts action over words. When he uses some common sense, he becomes an unconventional thinker. He’s concerned about the people around him, and they trust him. He’s basically everyone’s older brother.
杏鈴・杏璃の義兄。
イギリスの孤児院に預けられた日本人という、特殊な環境に育つ。
誠実でノリのいい好青年で、まずは行動タイプ。
常識を知った上で、型破り。
ムチャばかりするので周りから心配されるが信頼もされている、みんなのアニキ。

常識を知った上で、型破り。
ムチャばかりするので周りから心配されるが信頼もされている、みんなのアニキ。
"Heehee. You're just the cutest little thing, Yuu-kun♪"
Yuuto's homeroom teacher and grade-level coordinator. Saionji-sensei also happens to be Mizuho's uncle.
He is a dedicated teacher who's considerate of his students, but has a disconcerting love of cute boys.
From NekoNyan
"All girls are ladies, even when they're little. They're much more sensitive about things than boys are."
A girl who appears only before Yuuto. Nodoka is quite cheerful, and a bit cheeky, and also speaks with a wisdom that belies her appearance.
From NekoNyan
